opening.zh: 你好啊！今天过得怎么样？

playerText.en: Awesome! How about you?
playerText.zh: 我感觉棒极了！你呢？

playerText.en: I'm hanging in there.
playerText.zh: 我还活着。

playerText.en: '*Yawn*'
playerText.zh: *打哈欠*

npcReaction.en: Hey I'm talking to you now

playerText.en: Absolutely! And seeing you here just made my day even better.
playerText.zh: 没错！看见你更是让我的内心更加阳光灿烂了！

playerText.en: Yep. Let's get down to business.
playerText.zh: 嗯嗯。那我们谈正事吧。

playerText.en: Who cares about weather.
playerText.zh: 天气关我什么事。

opening.en: Hello! How has your day been so far?

playerText.en: Thank you for asking. Everything has been fantastic!
playerText.zh: 谢谢你的关心！一切都超顺利！

playerText.en: I'm fine. Let's get down to business.
playerText.zh: 我挺好。现在谈正事吧。

playerText.en: Terrible. Made it even worse that I have to deal with you.
playerText.zh: 糟透了，现在我还得应付你。

npcReaction.en: Umm, I guess it's not the best time to talk...

opening.en: Hey! I heard from your Boss you are very competent.

playerText.en: He's absolutely right and let me show you how competent I am.
playerText.zh: 老板说的没错，我现在就来给你展示我有多能干。

playerText.en: That's nice of him. Let's get down to business.
playerText.zh: 谢谢老板了。现在谈正事吧。

playerText.en: I have to be or else I get fired.
playerText.zh: 废话，求生欲让我们每个人都很能干。

playerText.en: Great! And you?
playerText.zh: 好极了，你呢？

playerText.en: 'I''m fine. '
playerText.zh: 我挺好。

npcReaction.en: Good. Let's get down to business then.
npcReaction.zh: 好的，那我们现在谈正事。

playerText.en: Not like you care anyway.
playerText.zh: 说得好像你真的在乎一样。

playerText.en: Thank you! It was a gift from one of my old friend.
playerText.zh: 谢谢！这可是我老朋友送给我的。

playerText.en: Oh thanks.
playerText.zh: 谢谢。

npcReaction.en: Good. Let's get down to business then.
npcReaction.zh: 好的，那我们现在谈正事。

playerText.en: '*Looking at phone*'
playerText.zh: *玩手机*

opening.en: Hey! What's your plan for the holiday coming in two months?
opening.zh: 嘿！你两个月后的假期准备做什么？

playerText.en: I'm going for a helicopter tour at Goatvale, with a bunch of friends. Can't wait!
playerText.zh: 我要跟我的一帮朋友去山羊谷开直升飞机，已经等不及啦！

playerText.en: Nothing special. Maybe traveling.
playerText.zh: 没什么特别的，也就到哪里旅游吧。

npcReaction.en: Good. Let's get down to business then.
npcReaction.zh: 好的，那我们现在谈正事。

playerText.en: Videogames.
playerText.zh: 宅家打游戏。

opening.en: What do you do for hobbies?

playerText.en: I'm taking classes and trying to get a helicopter lisence!
playerText.zh: 我正在上课准备考直升飞机驾照呢！

playerText.en: Nothing special. Hanging out with friends I guess?
playerText.zh: 没什么特别的，跟朋友聚会这种？

npcReaction.en: Good. Let's get down to business then.
npcReaction.zh: 好的，那我们现在谈正事。

playerText.en: Videogames.
playerText.zh: 宅家打游戏。

opening.en: Hey I need you to help me take care of these documents.
opening.zh: 我需要你帮我处理这些文件。

playerText.en: Sure! No problem!
playerText.zh: 当然！交给我吧！

playerText.en: Ok but it may take some time. I have all these meetings.
playerText.zh: 好，但这可能要花些时间，我今天很多会。

npcReaction.en: Please do it at your earliest convenience.

playerText.en: Stop bothering me with these tedious work!
playerText.zh: 别再那这些琐碎的事情烦我了好吗！

npcReaction.en: Oh well maybe I should talk to your boss..
npcReaction.zh: 我是不是该跟你领导谈谈...?

playerText.en: My favourite animial is standing right in front of me.
playerText.zh: 我最喜欢的动物现在就站在我眼前呢。

playerText.en: I like all of them.
playerText.zh: 我都喜欢。

npcReaction.en: You can't like all of them.

playerText.en: I like any animal who won't add more meetings to my schedule.
playerText.zh: 我喜欢一切不会给我增加更多会议的动物。

opening.en: Hey friend! Wanna join us for dinner tonight?
opening.zh: 嘿！今晚跟我们一起吃饭吧！

playerText.en: Sounds lovely. Do you guys prefer meat or veggies? I'll find a restaurant.
playerText.zh: 赞！你们是食肉派还是食草派？我去预定餐馆！

playerText.en: Sorry I'd love to go but I'm really tired and I have so much work.
playerText.zh: 抱歉。我真的很想去。但是我晚上要加班。

npcReaction.en: Hope you can join us next time!
npcReaction.zh: 希望下次你能加入我们！

playerText.en: 'Oh please... that''s off-work time. Would you just leave me alone? '
playerText.zh: 拜托！那是下班时间了，能不能放过我。

opening.en: What's your career plan in our company?
opening.zh: 你在我司的职业生涯是怎么规划的？

playerText.en: It may sound a bit ambitious but I'm working hard towards the head of dept. culture
playerText.zh: 虽然听起来有点好高骛远了，但我一直在为成为文化和多样性部长而努力。

playerText.en: Well, first I need to not get laid off.
playerText.zh: 我得先看到自己不被裁员才好思考下一步。

playerText.en: Not like I wouldn't get laid off if I say something nice here.
playerText.zh: 你说的好像我只要回答好这个问题就不会被裁员似的。

opening.en: Have you heard about what happend to Mrs. Bear yesterday?
opening.zh: 你听说昨天熊夫人的事情了吗？

playerText.en: Of course. I feel sorry for her but I'm sure she'll find a better lake to catch
playerText.zh: 当然，我为她感到遗憾，不过她肯定能找到更好的抓鱼的地方。

playerText.en: No. Tell me what happened.
playerText.zh: 没有。发生了什么？

npcReaction.en: Appearantly in the lake she usually catch fish from, all fish died in one night
npcReaction.zh: 貌似在她经常抓鱼的小河里，工厂的污水让所有的鱼一夜之间都死了。

playerText.en: Sorry I'm too burnt out to care about other people.
playerText.zh: 抱歉，我没功夫管别人的闲事。

playerText.en: Great! I went for a walk in the forest and saw Mr.Bear catching fish.
playerText.zh: 棒极了！我在森林里散了步并且看见了熊先生在抓鱼。

npcReaction.en: Cool. I need to catch up with Mr. Bear.
npcReaction.zh: 赞！我好久没跟熊先生联系了。

playerText.en: Not bad. Got some rest.
playerText.zh: 还好。休息了一阵子。

playerText.en: '*Ignore*'
playerText.zh: *无视*
